subject: Request: add elastic burst pool + billing cadence change (MSA exhibit redlines)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@brightwell.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: joe.armstrong@brightwell.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity + billing ask / MSA exhibit

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Brightwell is ready to move forward but we have two asks before we can sign:

1) Add an "elastic burst pool" of 200 vCPU-equivalent GPU hours per month that we can consume above committed capacity for spiky workloads (we'll only use it seasonally).
2) Move invoicing from monthly in arrears to quarterly invoicing (we need fewer POs).

We can accept a small list-price increase for the committed capacity if Redwood can include a modest burst-credit allowance and keep SLA terms intact.

Attaching a short note with the proposed billing cadence and estimated usage profile. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Procurement Manager, Brightwell Health
maya.patel@brightwell.ai
(415) 555-0199

Attachment: Brightwell_request_20260607.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Joe Armstrong <joe.armstrong@brightwell.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity + billing ask / MSA exhibit

Maya —

Appreciate the clarity and the use-case detail. We're aligned that Brightwell's seasonal spikes are a good fit for a burst pool. High-level proposal from our side:

- Commit: keep the originally quoted committed throughput (same term length).
- Burst pool: add 200 GPU-hour "elastic burst" allotment per month. Unused burst hours do not roll over.
- Pricing trade: 3% list price increase on committed capacity in exchange for the burst pool credit.
- Billing: we can accommodate quarterly invoicing but need the billing change reflected in the Order Form (pro-rated at signing for the first quarter).
- MSA: we need to add an Exhibit outlining burst pool mechanics, usage metering, and a surcharge clause if monthly consumption exceeds 3x the burst allotment in two consecutive months.

I'll loop in Legal and Finance to prepare a redline for the MSA Exhibit and updated Order Form. If that structure sounds acceptable, we will draft redlines and a DocuSign envelope for signature by EOD Wednesday.

Proposed next step: internal redline + one 30-min sync (Wed 10am PT) if you'd like to walk the exhibit.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
(650) 555-0122

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: (internal)
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: prep redlines for Brightwell (burst pool + billing cadence)

Karthik / Laura —

Brightwell (Maya / Joe) asked to add an "elastic burst pool" (200 GPU-hrs/mo) and move billing to quarterly. They are willing to accept a ~3% list-price bump on committed capacity in exchange for the burst credit. Please see their note (attached).

Deliverables:
- Karthik: draft MSA Exhibit for burst pool mechanics (metering, non-rollover, surcharge trigger at >3x for 2 consecutive months, data retention implications). Also flag any unusual risk in adding a surcharge clause; prefer precise language around "sustained overage" rather than open-ended "excess usage".
- Laura: confirm the billing change workflow and how we pro-rate for the first quarter; note if we need a different PO flow for Finance.

Attachments: Brightwell_request_20260607.pdf
Timeline: I want an internal redline by EOD Tue so we can send to Brightwell Wed morning (or DocuSign Wed afternoon). If you need more time, call me.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACTION: prep redlines for Brightwell (burst pool + billing cadence)

Hannah —

Quick review notes (internal):

1) Exhibit: I drafted an "Exhibit C: Elastic Burst Pool" redline. Key points: clear definition of burst hours, how we meter (per-minute tokenized billing), and that unused burst hours expire monthly. I've added language limiting Brightwell's right to dispute usage within 30 days of invoice.

2) Surcharge clause: proposed a tiered surcharge (first overage month = no surcharge, second consecutive overage month = 25% surcharge on overage tokens for that month). This provides behavioral incentive without immediate penalty. Flag: Finance needs to confirm if tiered surcharge is operationally acceptable (Laura).

3) Data retention / logs: added an audit log requirement (we will retain per-request usage logs for 180 days and provide them on request for disputes). That's less than their original ask (one year) but preferred from a storage/control perspective.

4) Billing cadence: Agree to quarterly invoices. Need to confirm pro-rate method for partial first quarter (offset by credits). Laura, can you confirm the pro-rate formula?

I'll attach the redline doc. If we intend to accept the 3% list bump, include that as a defined modification in the Order Form (not MSA).

-Karthik

Attachment: Redlines_MSA_Exhibit-BurstPool_20260609.docx
